abstract: Covers the OpenID AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 Final for Policy Enforcement Points that call a Policy Decision Point and for PDPs that implement it: the subject, resource, action and context information model, the Access Evaluation and Access Evaluations APIs, the Search APIs with pagination, PDP metadata at /.well-known/authzen-configuration, the HTTPS JSON binding, errors and security considerations. The working group's certification scenario and interop vectors are pinned to a repository commit. References are split into the information model, evaluation APIs, search APIs, metadata and transport, and conformance.

sources.title: AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 Certification Scenario
sources.revision: commit b304f68 (1 October 2026); draft posture: build when targeting certification, otherwise track

sources.title: AuthZEN interop scenarios and test vectors
